signs.OPEN_PALM: Palm toward camera, all five fingers straight and spread.
signs.FIST: Palm toward camera, four fingers curled and thumb across them.
signs.THUMB_UP: Closed fingers, thumb extended vertically upward.
signs.THUMB_DOWN: Closed fingers, thumb extended vertically downward.
signs.INDEX_UP: Palm toward camera, index straight up, other fingers and thumb folded.
signs.V_SHAPE: Palm toward camera, index and middle straight and spread, others folded.
signs.THREE_FINGERS: Index, middle and ring straight; little finger and thumb folded.
signs.FOUR_FINGERS: Four fingers straight and spread; thumb folded across palm.
signs.L_SHAPE: Index upward and thumb sideways, other three fingers folded.
signs.PINCH_CIRCLE: Thumb and index tips touching in a circle; other three fingers straight.
signs.LITTLE_UP: Only little finger straight upward; other fingers and thumb folded.
signs.THUMB_LITTLE: Thumb and little finger extended; other three fingers folded.
signs.REST: Visible relaxed, loosely curved hand; collect varied idle poses distinct from target signs.
